entities.name: Víctor Vargas
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Victor Vargas is a Venezuelan banker and businessman, best known for being the former owner and president of the 4th largest private bank in Venezuela, Banco Occidental de Descuento. The bank was recognized as the fourth largest private financial entity in Venezuela and was noted by reports for climbing the Forbes list of the world's most valuable companies. BOD was later integrated with another financial entity BNC.
